summary: V3.2 repairs the ordinary V3.1 lease methods, maps each normal-path root sentinel directly to the retained model handle, uses handle-relative no-follow opens, rejects reparse points and multi-link files, checks one-volume topology and cross-class identity disjointness, reports native architecture from Windows APIs, and keeps metadata, cloud, process, cleanup, and directory-member effects honest. Qualification still fails. NativeHandleLeaseV32 has a public state-taking constructor; _LeaseState, _IssuedResource, and _Api remain module-accessible; and the name-mangled state remains reachable. A deterministic fake-native counterexample constructed a caller-chosen unapproved leaf and caused probe_contention to call the native probe. Separately, the collector seals whatever thirteen target and three one-component sentinel strings the caller supplies; it never binds those inputs to the exact frozen allowlist descriptors, so the immutable map is caller-selected rather than exact. The supposedly exhaustive validator tests also miss Python numeric equivalence: target ordinal True and 1.0, sentinel ordinal 1.0, every float-valued governed count, and an equal-valued float source decision_count were accepted. The lease selector similarly resolves ordinal 1.0 as ordinal 1. Finally, validate_files has no parameters but reads mutable module globals, so reassignment restores caller-selected path access. These are source and deterministic no-filesystem counterexamples; no retained fixture, frozen artifact, live target, canonical target, OneDrive state, or restart state was touched.

findings.title: Public state construction and reachable internals preserve an alternate caller path to the native probe
normative_basis: V3.1 boss required no caller registration or retention API and no alternate path to a native write/delete-access probe

evidence.observation: _Api, _IssuedResource, and _LeaseState are module attributes. NativeHandleLeaseV32 publicly accepts any _LeaseState. Its name-mangled __state is reachable as _NativeHandleLeaseV32__state, and probe_contention trusts the supplied resource map before dispatching state.api._probe_contention.
The test suite itself constructs _LeaseState directly and invokes the public NativeHandleLeaseV32 constructor, proving this is an executable caller surface rather than a theoretical name lookup.

evidence.counterexample: Constructed matching fake parent/leaf identities, a caller-selected _IssuedResource leaf unapproved.json, a MappingProxyType resource map, _LeaseState, and NativeHandleLeaseV32. probe_contention('caller-forged', intent='write') returned CALLED and the fake native call log was [[10, 'unapproved.json', 'write']].

findings.risk: Removing retain/register methods from the returned ordinary lease does not create a capability boundary. A same-process caller can construct or replace the lease state and route a caller-selected parent/leaf to the native write/delete-access open primitive. The freeze claim that no alternate caller path exists is false.
findings.required_repair: Do not claim same-process Python name privacy as containment. Put native probing behind a separately reviewed broker or native boundary that mints and owns the resource table and accepts only authenticated server-issued selectors, or downgrade the helper to openly forgeable diagnostic evidence with no safe-native-surface qualification. Add a counterexample-shaped negative that attempts public construction, state replacement, and direct backend access and proves zero native probe calls.

findings.title: The sealed sixteen-resource map is immutable only after accepting caller-selected names
normative_basis: T550-V9-V3-1-NATIVE-PEER-001 required every token to bind one exact internally verified allowlist member

evidence.observation: collect_test_only_temp_root accepts caller target_tokens and sentinel_tokens, enforces only counts, uniqueness, target depth, and sentinel one-component shape, then issues all supplied strings. It never loads or compares the exact frozen target/sentinel descriptors.
Tests use synthetic target names. Sentinel negatives cover only nesting and dot/dotdot escape shapes; they do not prove that any other safe one-component sentinel name is rejected.

findings.risk: A caller can prepare any thirteen nested files and any three one-component files under a disposable model directory and receive a sealed resource map for them. MappingProxyType makes that selected map structurally read-only, but does not make it the exact governed map required by the boss.
findings.required_repair: Remove target and sentinel descriptor inputs from the collector surface. Load or embed the exact hash-bound frozen descriptors internally, derive all sixteen relative tokens and ordinals internally, and fail before every native open if the exact allowlist dependency or descriptor set drifts. Test every alternate safe target and sentinel descriptor with zero file-open and zero native-probe calls.

findings.title: Equal-valued bool and float mutations bypass the claimed exhaustive typed field matrix
normative_basis: V3.1 boss required exhaustive field mutation

evidence.observation: V3.2 delegates all object semantics to V3.1.
Counts and descriptor ordinals use Python equality without applying the strict _integer helper, so equal-valued floats and True for ordinal 1 compare equal.
The every-field matrix changes integers only by +1. Float/bool/negative mutations are applied only to targets[0].preimage_size_bytes, which already uses the strict _integer helper.

evidence.counterexample: validate_objects accepted target ordinal 1.0, target ordinal True, sentinel ordinal 1.0, float versions of all four governed counts, and equal-valued float source_render.decision_count.

evidence.observation: contention_token rejects bool but not float; dictionary key equality resolves ordinal 1.0 to the ordinal 1 token.

findings.risk: The validator and lease selector do not preserve the exact JSON integer type promised by the draft. The reported PASS_194 matrix overstates field-exhaustive type coverage.
findings.required_repair: Apply a strict non-bool bounded integer predicate to every ordinal, count, decision_count, accepted, held, size, and native selector ordinal before any equality or lookup. Parameterize bool, equal-valued float, negative, oversized, missing, and null mutations for every numeric field, not one representative size field.

findings.title: Zero parameters do not make mutable module path globals exact fixed inputs
normative_basis: V3.1 boss required a no-argument fixed-path-only file validator

evidence.observation: validate_files has no formal parameters, but it reads the publicly assignable module globals ALLOWLIST, PREDECESSOR_ALLOWLIST, and SOURCE_MANIFEST on every call.
Tests inspect only the function signature and reject positional/keyword arguments. They do not reassign a path global and prove the fixed entry point ignores it before filesystem access.

findings.risk: A caller can assign an alternate same-byte path, hardlink, or reparse path to a module global and invoke the nominally zero-argument validator. Hash equality constrains bytes but not the accessed location or metadata/cloud effect scope.
findings.required_repair: Derive the three exact paths inside validate_files from the hash-bound module location using non-rebindable local construction, or execute validation in a sealed launcher that does so. Add a no-effect negative that rebinds every exposed module path alias and proves the opened locations remain the exact three reviewed paths.

exact_hash_closure.details: The freeze, four assigned implementation/test artifacts, unchanged allowlist, and normative V3.1 boss ruling matched the supplied SHA-256 values.

ordinary_lease_api_repair.details: The returned lease has no ordinary retain, handle, register_resource, or issue methods. This is a useful API reduction but not containment because public state construction remains.

root_sentinel_normal_path.details: One-component sentinels derive parent_token '.', parent_handles['.'] is the retained model handle, and emitted sentinel parent_identity is the retained model identity.

unknown_selector_zero_probe.details: An unknown string selector is rejected before state.api._probe_contention. Public state forgery and float ordinal equivalence remain separate bypasses.

topology_and_identity.details: Directory traversal is retained-handle-relative with FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, every opened object rejects reparse/delete-pending drift, files require link_count one, all root/parent/file identity classes are disjoint, and all identities share the model volume.

architecture_source.details: The inherited exact-hash V3.1 backend obtains native architecture from GetNativeSystemInfo and IsWow64Process2.

effects_honesty.details: Process inventory, writer exclusion, directory-member delta, access metadata, cloud hydration, cleanup, production evidence, and canonical readiness remain explicit nonclaims.

static_default_cli.details: The exact V3.2 validator default invocation returned PASS_STATIC_ALLOWLIST_V3_2_VALIDATOR_ONLY. Mutable path globals and typed mutation gaps prevent qualification.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Removing public registration methods and using MappingProxyType is sufficient for a test-only Python helper.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The same-process constructor/state counterexample reaches the probe with an unapproved leaf. Test-only status limits consequence but does not make the containment claim true.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Any sixteen disposable fixture resources are adequate because the helper is not production.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The normative V3.1 boss repair explicitly requires each issued selector to bind an exact internally verified allowlist member. Count and shape are not descriptor identity.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Python equality is adequate because JSON ordinals and counts normally deserialize as integers.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: validate_objects is the documented injection seam, and the draft expressly claims bool/float rejection. Equal-valued alternate numeric types pass that seam today.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: No-argument signature alone satisfies fixed-path-only validation.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The filesystem entry point reads rebindable public path globals. The access path is therefore still caller-selectable within the same process.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The V3.2 normal-path root, topology, reparse, hardlink, architecture, and effects repairs remain useful.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Those repairs are real and should be preserved, but they do not override the independent capability, exact-map, typed-field, or fixed-path failures.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even a repaired bounded native collector and replacement protocol cannot exclude every pre-opened, future, hidden, kernel, sync, or noncooperating writer, nor eliminate all precheck-to-rename lost-update or post-readback races.

validation_performed.scope: exact freeze, assigned native and validator sources/tests, unchanged allowlist, and normative V3.1 boss ruling

validation_performed.details: Public constructor plus caller-built state dispatched one fake native probe for unapproved.json with write intent.
contention_token(kind='target', ordinal=1.0) returned the ordinal 1 token.
Equal-valued float/bool mutations described in finding 003 were accepted.

next_action: Preserve V3.2 and this dissent as non-authorizing rejected-draft evidence. Create a newly named generation that establishes an honest native capability boundary or removes the safe-surface claim, internally binds the exact sixteen frozen descriptors, strictly validates every numeric type including selector ordinals, and derives file-entry paths without rebindable caller globals. Obtain fresh native/validator peer, root challenge, premortem, and separate boss ruling before any component lock, launcher, live measurement, or canonical action.
